name: Wasp’s Sting (Ex)
body:
Prerequisites: Rogue/Ninja 6, Coldhearted Precision

Benefit: Whenever making an attack with a piercing weapon, the rogue/ninja may ignore an amount of any type of damage reduction equal to her Intelligence modifier.
